content.comment_body: Hello everyone, For a sauna control project, I need to manage an audio amplifier to play different sounds for each sauna infusion, which is also operated by [product_name]. The amplifier supports RS232 control, so I want to send text commands via TCP/IP from [product_name] to the amplifier. There are many TCP/IP to RS232 converter options available. My question is: can the latest [product_name] send text messages over TCP/IP? Thanks!

analysis.insight_summary: The user asked if the latest [product_name] module can send text commands over TCP/IP to control an amplifier with an RS232 interface. The response made clear that this function is not available, which creates a constraint for integration with external devices via RS232.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipated that the new [product_name] would be able to transmit custom text messages via TCP/IP, enabling control of external amplifiers through RS232 converters.
